summary: All five checklist areas pass. The anchor-vs-overlay test (lines 373–412) is fully value-based and load-bearing: it asserts id="in", class --target-anchor, data-handlepos===Position.Left, NOT --card-target on the anchor; id="in-drop", class --card-target on the drop overlay; and exactly one of each. The positioned-ancestor structural guard (lines 414–430) correctly asserts funnel-canvas-node class membership and both handles as descendants. handleConnect resolution is covered by two dedicated tests that drive targetHandle="in" and assert the emitted step/trigger payload by value. The output-handle selector at line 208 correctly excludes both handle-target and handle-drop without dropping real output coverage. No existing connect/drop/handle coverage was silently dropped. Two minor findings: one redundant legacy test and one stale comment — neither affects test efficacy.
